title: Helwit Violet Extra Strong Nicotine Pouches 15mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Violet Nicotine Pouches deliver a distinctive floral flavour inspired by classic violet sweets. The taste is aromatic and subtly sweet, with gentle herbal notes that give this pouch a uniquely nostalgic and unconventional profile. It's ideal for experienced users who appreciate flavours that go beyond the usual mint and fruit blends. Each pouch contains 15mg of nicotine and is designed to sit discreetly and comfortably under the lip, releasing nicotine gradually with no smoke, vapour or odour. Made from soft, plant-based fibres and manufactured in Sweden using climate-compensated processes, Helwit Violet offers a bold, individual experience in a high-strength pouch. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
